_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Double-clicking a conversation name renames it and Escape cancels. A conversation exists at /c/{{SLUG}}, row [data-conversation-id="{{ID}}"]; "the title" is that row's ".conversation-title" and "the input" its ".drawer-rename-input". To "reload" the page: eval "window.__beforeReload = true; location.reload()" (no expect), then poll eval "window.__beforeReload === undefined && document.readyState === 'complete'" expecting true. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is the element with role button (a <button>) whose accessible name (aria-label, else its text) is exactly X; "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. A single click still opens the conversation: click the title. 3. The URL's path should become exactly /c/{{SLUG}} (poll eval "location.pathname"). 4. The row has no ".drawer-rename-input" element. 5. Double-click the title (click with count 2). 6. The input is focused (document.activeElement) and its value is exactly "{{SLUG}}". 7. Fill the input with "discarded-name". 8. Press Escape. 9. The title's text is exactly "{{SLUG}}". 10. Navigate to /new. 11. Double-click the title. 12. The input is focused. 13. Fill the input with "{{NEW_SLUG}}". 14. Press Enter. 15. The title's text should become exactly "{{NEW_SLUG}}". 16. Reload. 17. The title's text is exactly "{{NEW_SLUG}}". 18. Click the title. 19. The URL's path should become exactly /c/{{NEW_SLUG}} (poll eval "location.pathname").
